deadline.value: Each application is reviewed when received, and the admission decision follows the committee's review.
deadline.quote: Upon receipt, each application is reviewed by the Academic Committee of the Doctorate Program (CAPD).

supervisor.value: A professor of the programme must agree to act as tutor before the candidate is admitted.
supervisor.quote: Having a professor of the Program who values positively the skills and motivation of the candidate, and who accepts to act as a tutor

funding.value: UPC predoctoral grants are awarded through annual general calls; the programme pages do not say how many students are funded.
funding.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: Holders of a 300-ECTS Spanish bachelor's degree are eligible (with bridging courses), as are holders of a Spanish bachelor's and master's.
entry_route.quote: Holders of an official Spanish bachelor’s degree which, in accordance with EU regulations, carries at least 300 ECTS credits

also.quote: Being in possession of an official Spanish degrees of Grado and Master.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: Fluent English must be shown by interview or an official certificate (Cambridge, TOEFL, IELTS, TOEIC, EOI); no waiver for Indian or English-medium degrees is stated.

notes: Other UPC doctorates in electrical and electronic fields (Electrical Engineering, Signal Theory and Communications, Automatic Control, Robotics and Vision, Network Engineering, Electric Energy Systems) are not separate records; this record covers the Electronic Engineering programme only. Admission request is made through the UPC pre-enrolment site.
name: PhD in Electronic Engineering
